guide.core_utilities.alloys.text:
The Alloy Smelter combines two inputs:

Iron Ingot + 2 Coal Dust: Steel Ingot
Gold Ingot + 4 Redstone: Energized Ingot
Energized Ingot + Ender Pearl: Ender Alloy Ingot
4 Netherite Scrap + 4 Gold: Netherite Ingot

The Compressor presses ingots into plates, and 64 Coal Dust into a diamond.

Basic gear needs only vanilla items. Steel and gold plates unlock Advanced Circuits and the Advanced Machine Frame; Ender Alloy unlocks the Elite tier.
guide.core_utilities.alloys.title: Alloys & tiers
guide.core_utilities.breaker.text:
The Block Breaker breaks the block in front of it as soon as there is one, which makes cobblestone generators and tree farms easy. The Block Placer places blocks from its inventory in front of it.

Both respect the redstone mode, so you can pulse them with a clock.
guide.core_utilities.breaker.title: Breaker & Placer
guide.core_utilities.cables.text:
Cables carry energy instantly to every block on the network that accepts it, shared fairly between them. They hold no energy and do no work when nothing flows, so large networks cost almost nothing.

Basic: 512 FE/t per network
Advanced: 4,096 FE/t
Elite: 32,768 FE/t

Different tiers do not connect to each other. Right-click a face with the wrench to disconnect it from a machine or cable.
guide.core_utilities.cables.title: Cables
guide.core_utilities.cells.text:
Store energy for the night or for bursty machines.

Basic: 1M FE, 2k FE/t
Advanced: 8M FE, 16k FE/t
Elite: 64M FE, 128k FE/t

By default every face is an input and the front is an output that pushes energy every tick. Change any face in the Sides panel of the GUI. Cells keep their charge when you break them.
guide.core_utilities.cells.title: Energy Cells
guide.core_utilities.combustion.text:
Burns any furnace fuel, including fuels from other mods, for 40 FE/t. A piece of coal gives 64,000 FE, a lava bucket 800,000 FE (the empty bucket stays in the slot).

It only starts burning new fuel when its buffer has room, so nothing is wasted. Speed upgrades burn faster for more FE/t; energy upgrades add 10% output each.
guide.core_utilities.combustion.title: Combustion
guide.core_utilities.energy.text:
All machines use FE (also called RF). Generators fill their own buffer and push it into anything touching them that accepts energy. Machines accept energy on every face.

Right-click a block with the Multimeter to read how much energy it holds. Right-click a cable to see how many conduits and connections its network has and how much it can carry.

A comparator next to any machine outputs a signal proportional to its stored energy.
guide.core_utilities.energy.title: Energy (FE)
guide.core_utilities.farming.text:
Place the Crop Harvester among your crops. It checks its own layer and the one above in a 9x9 area, harvests anything fully grown and replants it from the drops: wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroot, nether wart, cocoa, sweet berries, melons, pumpkins, sugar cane and cactus.

Put bone meal in its input slot and it will also fertilize young crops.
guide.core_utilities.farming.title: Crop Harvester
guide.core_utilities.geothermal.text:
Makes 15 FE/t for every lava source block touching one of its six faces, up to 90 FE/t. The lava is never consumed, so a Nether lava lake is a free power plant.

It pushes energy into every neighbour that is not lava.
guide.core_utilities.geothermal.title: Geothermal
guide.core_utilities.grinder.text:
The Mob Grinder damages every mob in an area in front of it and vacuums up their drops. It never touches players, named mobs or bosses.

Each hit costs 200 FE. Range upgrades make the area bigger, speed upgrades hit more often.
guide.core_utilities.grinder.title: Mob Grinder
guide.core_utilities.machines.text:
Every machine has a GUI with its energy bar on the left and a Sides panel on the right. Click a face (Front, Back, Left, Right, Top, Bottom) to cycle it between Disabled, Input, Output and Input + Output. Hoppers, pipes and other mods use these faces.

The tabs on the left set the redstone mode (ignored, run while powered, run while unpowered) and Auto-eject, which pushes finished items into inventories on output faces.

Wrench: right-click rotates a machine, sneak + right-click dismantles it.
guide.core_utilities.machines.title: Machines & sides
guide.core_utilities.ores.text:
The Crusher turns one ore block into two dusts (copper ore gives six), and raw ore into one dust with a 50% chance of a second. Smelt the dusts in an Electric Furnace, which runs any furnace recipe twice as fast as a vanilla furnace.

It also crushes coal into Coal Dust, cobblestone into gravel, gravel into sand, blaze rods into four blaze powder, bones into six bone meal and diamond, emerald, lapis, redstone and quartz ores into extra gems.
guide.core_utilities.ores.title: Ore doubling
guide.core_utilities.pipes.text:
Pipes move items between inventories, including chests, furnaces and other mods' machines.

Right-click the face of a pipe that touches an inventory with the wrench to set it to extract (orange arrow). Every few ticks it pulls items out and delivers them to the other inventories on the network, round robin. Wrench again to turn that face off, and once more to reconnect it.

Item Pipe: 4 items every 0.5s
Rapid Item Pipe: 32 items every 0.25s
guide.core_utilities.pipes.title: Item Pipes
guide.core_utilities.quarry.text:
The Quarry mines a 9x9 area below itself, one layer at a time, all the way down to bedrock. It skips fluids, unbreakable blocks, blocks with inventories and anything in the core_utilities:drill_machine tag.

Each block costs 400 FE. Range upgrades widen the area by 2 blocks per upgrade (up to 33x33), speed upgrades mine faster. Mined items fill its buffer; give it an output face with a chest or pipe and Auto-eject on.
guide.core_utilities.quarry.title: Quarry
guide.core_utilities.solar.text:
Solar panels need a clear view of the sky. They make full power on clear days, half in rain, a quarter in thunderstorms and nothing at night.

Solar Panel: 20 FE/t
Advanced: 80 FE/t
Elite: 320 FE/t
Ultimate: 1280 FE/t

Panels push their energy down and sideways, so put a cable or machine under them.
guide.core_utilities.solar.title: Solar Panels
guide.core_utilities.upgrades.text:
Each machine has three upgrade slots that take up to 8 upgrades in total.

Speed Upgrade: +50% speed each, at a higher energy cost per tick.
Energy Upgrade: -15% energy per tick each.
Range Upgrade: +2 blocks radius for the Quarry, Crop Harvester and Mob Grinder.
guide.core_utilities.upgrades.title: Upgrades
guide.core_utilities.utilities.text:
The original Core Utilities blocks are still here:

Pushing Plates launch entities; effect plates heal, speed up or harm whoever stands on them.
Filters only let certain entities through. Right-click a filter with the wrench to invert it.
Backpacks carry 9, 18 or 27 stacks.
The Mob Net captures a mob to carry it somewhere else.
The Floating Block can be placed in mid-air.
guide.core_utilities.utilities.title: Utility blocks
guide.core_utilities.welcome.text:
Core Utilities is a compact technology mod: power, storage, logistics and automation without endless chains. Every block works with Forge Energy on Forge and NeoForge, and with Team Reborn Energy on Fabric, so it plugs into your other tech mods.

Start with a Combustion Generator or a Solar Panel, run Basic Energy Cables to an Electric Furnace and a Crusher, and grow from there. Hover any block in the item list for its numbers; JEI shows every machine recipe.
guide.core_utilities.welcome.title: Welcome
